title: Barnaby at eight, v
logline: Friday. Before the Sunday: the walk, once more, drawn as the route on a map — the alley, the road, the post, the stairs, the log — with the dog's line on it. The map of a dog's life so far. Wood pins it.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD drawing a map: the alley, the beach road, the post, the stairs, the beach, the log. A dotted line along it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man drawing a small hand-lettered map of a walking route from an alley to a beach with a dotted line along it, a dog beside him

panels.composition: The map. The dotted line. At the post, a small loop. At the log, an X. In a corner: 1999–.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a hand-drawn map of a short walking route with a dotted line, a small loop at a post and an X at a log
image.notes: Letter after: 1999– in the corner. Open-ended.

panels.composition: The dog looking at the map. Not recognizing it. It's his; he's never seen it from above.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a dog looking at a map on a table without recognition, no words

panels.composition: The map pinned to the corkboard, beside the 1999 schedule. Two routes. One taken every day.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man pinning a small hand-drawn map to a corkboard beside a folded bus schedule, no words
image.notes: Corkboard inventory: the walk map, July 2007.

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The walk as a map, 1999–. Pinned beside the schedule.
